A Volcanic Eruption

一次火山喷发 · 205 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1As the best candidate, I was appointed to collect and evaluate information for a database on diverse natural disasters such as hurricanes, typhoons and thunderstorms. Sometimes I did this by giving out questionnaires to those who went through them. But sometimes I had to go through actual disasters myself. The eruption of Mount Musaki was one of those occasions.

2At that time, I lived in a bungalow alongside the volcano with a novelist who had come to observe an eruption. One day, when I was drawing diagrams on the balcony and he was bathing inside, the volcano erupted unexpectedly. The fountains of ash and lava shooting high into the sky varied from 50 to 100 meters in height. It was absolutely fantastic! I even noticed a rainbow appear in the fog caused by a heat wave.

3But, glancing around, I foresaw the potential danger and found no guarantee of our safety. The unpleasant fumes almost made us unconscious. I began to sweat with anxiety. Managing to stop panicking and trembling, we quickly put on our protective suits, helmets and boots and eventually made our way to a safe place. How lucky we were even though my precious equipment and documents were all destroyed by fire!

高考英语3500词 · 30中文译文

一次火山喷发

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1作为最合适的人选，我被派去收集和评估各种自然灾害的资料，为数据库提供信息。这些灾害包括飓风、台风和雷暴。我有时给亲历者发问卷，有时也得亲自经历灾害。穆萨基火山那次就是其中之一。

2那时，我和一位小说家一起住在火山边的一座平房里。他是为了亲眼观察喷发而来的。一天，我正在阳台上画示意图，他在屋里洗澡，火山突然喷发了。火山灰和熔岩喷向高空，高度在五十到一百米之间。景象真是惊人！热浪带起的雾气里，我甚至看到了一道彩虹。

3不过，我扫了一眼周围，就预感到有危险，根本没有把握能平安无事。刺鼻的气体差点让我们失去知觉。我焦虑得直冒汗。我们努力稳住心神，不再惊慌发抖，迅速穿上防护服和靴子，戴好头盔，终于走到了安全的地方。虽然我珍贵的设备和文件全烧毁了，我们能脱险已经够幸运了！
